The '''Green Jedi Council''' was the governing body of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]], a sect of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Green Jedi were led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arfan Ramos]], though Ramos and the Council were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperial forces during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
